itemized_evaluation.justification: Section 6 explicitly discloses full funding and competing interests: 'Funding: zero received; independent research... D.S. is the founder and a beneficiary of FreshCredit Inc. and the founder of The FreshCredit Lab. FreshCredit Inc holds granted US utility patents covering methods in three commercial verticals (finance, commerce, and insurance): US 12,236,480 B2; US 12,293,410 B2; US 12,307,515 B2; US 12,293,411 B2...'

The paper is an un-refereed commercial/technical whitepaper with placeholder repository links and un-deposited supporting documents: 'OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/TBD)... The Supporting Document and Technical Appendix are in preparation (see collection index); until they are deposited, the frozen-criteria and protocol claims that cite them are self-attested.'

Citations are represented with strict accuracy, explicitly grading evidence and noting vendor biases, sample limitations, and critiques: 'Consumer Reports, 2024 — volunteer sample, not nationally representative; cited alongside the FTC’s representative 2013 estimate of 26%... (Suri & Jack, 2016, Science, agent-proximity instrument; causality contested by Bateman, Duvendack & Loubere, 2019, and the critique is carried).'

Section 6 explicitly documents independent replications and reproducible protocols: 'The empirical underwriting findings independently replicate the large-scale cash-flow default reduction findings of FinRegLab (2019, 2021; N = 85,000 borrowers across 6 financial institutions) and replicate the CFPB's national error rate through automated, live REST API queries to the public CFPB Consumer Complaint Database (2,360,000+ public records; experiments/simulations_repair_era/whitepaper/query_cfpb_complaints.py).'

Sampling and measurement biases are explicitly analyzed, controlled in simulations, and bounded: 'wearable owners differ systematically from non-owners, so the concordance pilot’s population inference carries a self-selection caveat... The complaint-database statistics are stated against their exact counting base... Two confounds bound the interpretation: (i) the issue labels are self-classified by complainants, not adjudicated; (ii) intake volume is not verified-harm volume...'

While simulation sample sizes are reported (e.g., N=300 synthetic users, N=500 Kuramoto nodes, 2M Monte Carlo files) and large external datasets are cited, no explicit statistical power calculation is provided for the simulations or the proposed concordance pilot study.

The methodology employs rigorous negative controls, semantic/paraphrase controls, and incumbent control benchmarks: 'A planted \lambda = 0 negative control recovers max|\hat{\lambda}| = 0.0092 (no phantom sensitivity)... shuffled-label negative control correctly null (p = 0.684)... CLICS provides the semantic control geometry... Section 2.3 The incumbent control group: measured alternative-data results.'

Appropriate statistical tests (Mantel permutation tests, Kalman/EM state-space estimation, coalitional Shapley values) are paired with explicit effect sizes, pre-registered smallest effect sizes of interest (SESOI), and practical significance metrics: 'The 0.15 half-width is a pre-registered smallest effect size of interest (SESOI) for an equivalence test... latent trajectory recovery r = 0.879 (threshold 0.7); \hat{\lambda} recovery error 0.024 against the certified tolerance 0.15...'

Randomization seeds, simulation parameter distributions, and demographic breakdowns are fully detailed: '300 synthetic users, true \lambda ~ U[0.05, 0.95], mixed-sign \tilde{\varepsilon} streams (12–15% negative, heavier-tailed betrayals), Poisson cadence 0.3–3.0 events/day over 365 days (median 569 events/user, range 112–1100)... invisibility concentrated among Black (28%) and Hispanic (26%) consumers versus 16% of White and Asian consumers, and 40% of invisibles under 25.'

Exact p-values, means, standard deviations, and percentile bounds (p5, p95, max) are reported throughout: 'reports |\hat{\lambda} - \lambda| mean 0.0074, p95 0.0215, max 0.0343... Mantel r = 1.0, p = 0.002; partial concordance given text p = 0.002; shuffled-label negative control correctly null (p = 0.684)... R = 0.739 \pm 0.029 coupled vs. 0.040 \pm 0.001 isolated... uptake 0.725 -> 0.284, p = 0.004.'

Raw numbers, baselines, absolute vs. relative risks, PPV against prevalence, and NNT/NNH are explicitly provided: 'Where effects are quantified we report relative risk alongside absolute risk differences, and — following diagnostic convention — specificity before sensitivity, with predictive values always stated against their prevalence... Section 4.3 Harm accounting — the in-paper NNH analysis... Section 4.4 The benefit ledger at matched granularity... NNT is 52 / 24 / 19... NNH \approx 1.03 wrongful flags per flag at 1% prevalence.'

Missing data, bureau record exclusions, and simulation failures are fully logged and accounted for: 'after one bureau’s submissions were found to have excluded whole record categories (files containing only deferred student loans, collections, or closed accounts)... database counts differ from total receipts because not all complaints are published... the multilingual arms failed their frozen criteria and are reported as failed... A second-encoder replication attempt (Sim D9...) also failed its frozen criteria and is reported as failed.'

The paper explicitly distinguishes its surrogate compliance metric from true trustworthiness and prevents construct conflation: 'contract-enforced repayment is, in Yamagishi’s terms, the assurance channel — validation drawn from institutions and sanctions — not the vulnerability-based trust channel... The score therefore measures calibrated compliance dynamics, which correlate with trustworthiness [HYPOTHESIS] but are not identical to it... Whose loop this is — the construct discipline.'

Statistical significance is rigorously separated from practical and clinical impact: 'The 0.15 half-width is a pre-registered smallest effect size of interest (SESOI) for an equivalence test — a substantive choice, not instrument resolution: the instrument’s demonstrated recovery error is far finer (mean 0.0074...), so the corridor is conservative in the direction of easy corroboration — and H2 corroboration is therefore weak evidence...'

Correlation is explicitly separated from causation, and third-factor confounders and observation/Hawthorne effects are extensively analyzed: 'Critically, the credit–health correlation is substantially confounded: in the Dunedin cohort (N = 1,037), human-capital factors (education, cognition, self-control) explain ~45% of the credit-score–cardiovascular-risk association (Israel et al., 2014, PNAS) — third factors, not credit denial, do much of the work... Accordingly, this document does not claim the incumbent system "is a morbidity exposure."... demand characteristics show heterogeneous, bidirectional participation effects with frequent nulls (McCambridge, 2014).'

Figures and captions explicitly document baselines, log scales, and potential mapping distortions: 'A half-circle (arctan) phase map would inflate the K = 0 control to R \approx 0.635; the incoherent baseline under the stereographic map is \approx 0.03–0.05 (Figure 7)... (a) Fee totals (log scale) (Figure 12).'

Hypotheses and pass/fail criteria were frozen prior to running simulations, and failed tests are transparently reported rather than p-hacked: 'The full machinery has been run end-to-end on synthetic users with known ground truth, against pre-registered criteria frozen in code before the passing run... the registered follow-up that removes the caveat has been run and fails the estimator (SIM-R1 battery 1, seed 42)...'

Simulation timeframes are logically scaled to capture long-term dynamics, cold-start traps, and multi-year transitions: 'Poisson cadence 0.3–3.0 events/day over 365 days... Adopted fraction after 10 years over (organic floor x \zeta) (Figure 11)... Sim W9: Dynamic Lemons Market Solvency ODE under 36-Month Transitional Migration (Figure 11).'

Extrapolation limits, domain boundaries, and model break-even regions are explicitly bounded: 'The transfer caveat is carried explicitly: the battery’s own retrieval/alignment nulls and the D11/D13 stimulus-class fork... show the anchor’s representational geometry is stimulus-class-sensitive... No DebtRank-form cascade exercise is carried (companion protocol preprint, Sim P6): DebtRank is an interbank balance-sheet exposure model — a category error for data custody...'

Mathematical formulations enforce strict domain and numerical stability bounds: 'regularization floor \epsilon_{\min} = 10^{-4} certifying numerical stability against zero-variance history profiles... with the trust index \iota(T) = \tanh(w\,\tilde{T}) \in (-1, 1)... at neutral trust \iota = 0 it reduces exactly to standard expected utility, and the distortion is bounded — trust reweights evidence but never manufactures outcomes.'
